name: API Insight Lab
description: A comprehensive API testing suite with load testing, request chaining, environment management, snapshots, and detailed analytics.
project_description: API Insight Lab is a React-based admin dashboard for load-testing and inspecting HTTP/REST APIs from inside Drupal. It ships a single admin page at /admin/config/development/api-insight-lab (gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission) that mounts a bundled React SPA; the SPA drives a large set of JSON controller endpoints under /api/perf-test/*. The Load Tester fires concurrent Guzzle requests (1-100 virtual users x 1-1000 iterations, k6-style, with optional warmup/ramp-up/sustain/ramp-down phases) against a target URL and reports RPS, latency percentiles (p50-p99), standard deviation, a DNS/TCP/TLS/server/download bottleneck breakdown, cache hit/miss counts (from X-Drupal-Cache), and pass/warn/fail grades. Results and configurations are stored in seven bespoke content entities: presets (api_test_config), assertions (api_assertion), snapshots (api_snapshot), environment profiles (environment_profile), request chains (request_chain), plus legacy api_perf_result and api_perf_setting. Additional features: response assertions (status code, response time, body-contains, JSONPath, header checks), request chaining with JSONPath variable extraction and {{variable}} substitution, environment profiles with base-URL and variable templating, snapshot save/compare/diff, config import/export with URL remapping, and REST/JSON:API endpoint auto-discovery. The module also registers a set of intentionally public dummy test endpoints under /api/test/* (health, echo, delay, status, users, login, protected, orders, random) that return static or randomised mock data for exercising the tool. Depends only on core's REST module.
